theorems.name: Submission.exists_radial_cutoff_test_field
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (K : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (ξ : Ambient n ℓ) (R ε : ℝ), IsCompact K → 0 ≤ R → 0 < ε → ∃ (ζ : Ambient n ℓ → ℝ) (γ : ℝ → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ ∧ (∀ x ∈ K, ζ x = 1 ∧ gradient ζ x = 0) ∧ ContDiff ℝ 1 γ ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → 0 ≤ γ t ∧ 0 ≤ deriv γ t) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ R + ε → γ t = 0) ∧ (∀ t : ℝ, R + ε < t → 0 < γ t) ∧ IsTestField (closedBall ξ R)ᶜ (fun x ↦ (ζ x * γ ‖x - ξ‖) • (x - ξ))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
